The background features baseball equipment like gloves and bats hanging on a wall, and large advertisements for brands like Domino's Pizza and Rakuten are visible on the dugout wall. (3) The camera pans back to the baseball player who is listening quietly with a slight smile, his hands resting on his knees. Another person in sports attire walks past in the far background. (4) The player reacts to a comment by looking down and laughing shyly, while the camera remains focused on him. The lighting is bright and consistent with a stadium indoor environment.
